preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the permutation n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation p must be a distinct integer between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of operations needed to have exactly one inversion in the permutation.
